prompt: White fixes the streetlamp before dark
title: Light the Streetlamp
irony: White the fixer who never stops fixing only lights the lamp when she stops fixing and lets the kids' hands and a hug finish the job.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Low sun warms the quiet street while White eyes the tall unlit lamp post.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green hauls dinosaur books to read under the lamp while White fiddles nonstop with her toolbox.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: The lamp stays dim as shadows grow, and Black dares the kids to stay out till dusk.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The friends gather round the dim lamp and sing out for its glow to return.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: White climbs the ladder and twists the bulb, but her wrench slips and the lamp stays dim.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The loose bulb rolls bouncing down the street past Yellow's porch while everyone chases it.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Breathless under the dim post, the friends sing the lamp chant once more together.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: White looks at her busy hands and softly owns that fixing alone leaves no room for love.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: White puts the tools down, asks for small hands, and Green shows where the bulb sits.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Together they lift the warm bulb home and the whole street glows gold at last.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Bathed in lamp glow, the friends curl up with books while White hums and holds them close.
